forms.name: Slash
forms.decision: Consider when several enemies pressure the same space.

forms.name: Slice
forms.knownUse: High single-target damage, with a previewed bonus from behind.
forms.decision: Consider when positioning for a focused target matters.

forms.name: Crush
forms.decision: Pairs a heavier option with a faster Primary Form.

forms.name: Drill
forms.knownUse: Directed, sustained damage in the hands-on build.

forms.name: Extend
